exposure: low back and pelvic girdle pain (LBPP)
outcome: Correlation between LBPP and functional disability
Correlation between risk of depression/anxiety and functional disability
Prevalence ratio of LBPP with increased risk of depression/anxiety
Prevalence ratio of increased risk of depression/anxiety with LBPP
Level of disability in women with LBPP and concurrent increased risk of depression/anxiety compared to those with LBPP and lower depression/anxiety symptoms
finding: This study found a high level of co-occurrence of low back and pelvic pain, functional disability, and depression/anxiety in women in their third trimester of pregnancy.
